theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Facts From Fiction
body: Myth: You need lump sum to invest. Fact: Start small with systematic investments. Consistency builds wealth over time.
caption: Many believe mutual fund investing requires large upfront amounts. Regular, disciplined contributions work equally well for long-term wealth creation. Start your investment journey at your own pace. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingSmart #WealthBuilding #LongTermWealth #InvestmentBasics
